nvitk.registry.containers
=========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.registry.containers

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Read ``registry/containers/registry/containers.json`` and resolve cluster SIF paths.

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: _NVITK_CONTAINER_RE

.. py:data:: _DEFAULT_CLUSTER_ROOT

.. py:data:: _NVITK_PROJECT
   :value: 'nvitk'


.. py:function:: _find_repo_root() -> pathlib.Path | None

   Walk up from this file to the repo root (dir with ``pyproject.toml`` and ``src/nvitk``).


.. py:function:: registry_path() -> pathlib.Path | None

   Locate ``containers.json`` (canonical path or legacy symlink).


.. py:function:: load_container_registry() -> dict[str, Any]

   Load and parse ``containers.json``; returns an empty dict if it is missing or malformed.


.. py:function:: _project_entry(registry: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None

   Return the ``containers.projects[name]`` sub-dict, or ``None`` if absent/mis-typed.


.. py:function:: _version_entry(project: dict[str, Any], version: str | None) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]] | None

   Resolve ``(version, entry)`` for *project*, defaulting to ``latest`` then the highest key.


.. py:function:: default_cluster_sif_path(project_name: str, version: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Default samwise deploy path when ``cluster_sif_path`` is absent.


.. py:function:: resolve_cluster_sif_path(project_name: str, *, version: str | None = None, registry: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Cluster Singularity path for a project container (``cluster_sif_path`` or convention).


.. py:function:: resolve_nvitk_cluster_sif(*, version: str | None = None) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Cluster SIF path for the ``nvitk`` container itself (convenience wrapper).


.. py:function:: _is_nvitk_container_path(value: str) -> bool

   True when *value* names an ``nvitk_v<version>.sif`` container.


.. py:function:: sync_sge_nvitk_container(sge_path: pathlib.Path, *, version: str | None = None, dry_run: bool = False) -> pathlib.Path

   Set ``paths.nvitk_container`` and nvitk pipeline ``default_sge_container_root``
   from registry ``projects.nvitk.latest``.


.. py:function:: sync_default_sge_json(*, version: str | None = None, dry_run: bool = False) -> pathlib.Path

   Sync repo ``.nvitk/sge.json`` from registry latest nvitk.
